text:
maya: customer reports inconsistent embedding dimensionality when traffic routes between Hosted, Dedicated and Private. same input, same model name, but dims flip between 1536 and 1024 depending on where the request landed. posting initial details.

maya: quick summary: request_id=abc123, model=rwd-embed-1, sdk: node 3.2.1, curl repro below. Hosted -> dims=1536, Dedicated -> dims=1536, Private -> dims=1024 (intermittent). customer saw behavior after we enabled smart-routing across deployments.

maya: minimal repro (sanitized):
```bash
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-embed-1","input":"the quick brown fox","batch_size":1}' \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings
```

maya: example responses (trimmed):
response hosted:
```
{"request_id":"abc123","embedding":[0.012,0.003,...],"dims":1536}
```
response private (when fallback triggered):
```
{"request_id":"abc123","embedding":[-0.02,0.11,...],"dims":1024}
```

jia: can you paste the route_policy id and the routing decision record? need to confirm which variant was picked.

maya: route_policy: rp-77, routing decision: prefer:dense@hosted -> fallback:quant@dedicated -> fallback:quant@private. customer traffic hit fallback quant on private for some requests.

oliver: @maya thanks. two quick possibilities: (1) aliasing in the model catalog points to a different-arch model (1024 dims) for the quant variant, or (2) quantized variant preserved dims but runtime truncated the vector due to kernel mismatch. can you dump the model catalog entries for rwd-embed-1*?

eng-ml-bot: found entries in catalog index (sanitized):
```
- model_id: rwd-embed-1
  base_dims: 1536
  architecture: embed-v3
  precision: fp16

- model_id: rwd-embed-1-quant
  base_dims: 1024
  precision: int8
  alias_of: rwd-embed-lite-v2
```

infra-ops: whoa — looks like rwd-embed-1-quant is actually aliasing to a different family (embed-lite) with 1024 dims. that would explain dimension mismatch when router falls back to that variant.

maya: customer confirms they never asked for a different dimension; they relied on alias names to route to an internal "quant" variant. apparently the alias was repointed during a catalog cleanup.

oliver: immediate mitigation options: (A) update route policy to avoid rwd-embed-1-quant until alias fixed, (B) update alias to point to a quantized variant of rwd-embed-1 that preserves 1536, (C) add router guard to refuse routing to a candidate whose base_dims != requested_dims. I'll prepare a fix path.

support-bot: escalation created INC-2026-4879 for customer ticket #89234.

oliver: taking (B)+(C). will push alias update + router guard. PR incoming.

deploy-bot: started deploy deploy-embed-alias-fix (id dpl-9923) by oliver

infra-ops: suggested router guard behavior: when routing candidate.model.base_dims != request.expected_dims then don't route and record metric embed.dim_mismatch, return 409 with header X-Redwood-Embed-Dim: expected=1536, candidate=1024 and suggestion header X-Redwood-Candidate-Model. also log routing decision for audit.

jia: please add integration test: simulate rp-77 policy across regions with mixed deployments and assert dims preserved. add regression alert if embed.dim_mismatch rate > 0.1% over 1h.

oliver: PR: github.com/redwood/serving/pull/4187 adds alias update and router guard + metric. rolling out to staging now.

deploy-bot: deploy dpl-9923 succeeded in region us-west-2

maya: customer ran quick check after deploy: hosted/dedicated/private all returned dims=1536 for the same request_id abc123. customer: "looks good on our side, thanks" :white_check_mark:

maya: closing loop with customer; asked them to monitor for 48h and escalate if they see dim flips again.

infra-ops: created runbook note and internal doc: /docs/embeddings/aliasing-dim-check — includes checklist: verify alias_of preserves base_dims, add preflight on alias edits, router will now reject mis-dimensioned candidates.

oliver: follow-ups: (1) catalog UI validation on alias edits to warn when dims change, (2) metric dashboard for embed.dim_mismatch, (3) add e2e smoke that checks vector dims across deployments after any catalog change.

maya: thanks all. marking resolved for now. will re-open if customer sees any regression. :eyes:
